title: Foundation, Conductor and toolchain
claim_boundary: Five of six foundation assertions are source implemented with commit-bound local GNU compiler/test evidence and hosted cross-platform compiler checks. Upstream repository-standards registration and estate conformance remain externally blocked, and the required dependency-trust gate is red; this is not a green aggregate verify.sh receipt.

assertions.statement: Record upstream Conductor 0.3.0 and supported host installation paths
assertions.permitted_claim: The 0.3.0 repository baseline and supported installers are recorded; Gemini CLI has a separately recorded enabled Conductor 0.4.1 host.

assertions.statement: Create product, guidelines, stack, workflow, requirements and design context
assertions.permitted_claim: The Conductor handshake and linked project context resolve locally. The native read-only v3 status adapter reconciles registry, plans, evidence and in-place archive state with adversarial tests; it neither executes inspected-root code nor promotes external gates.

assertions.statement: Pin Rust stable and document nightly/experimental policy
assertions.permitted_claim: Rust 1.97.1 is pinned; exact GNU compiler execution passed locally and hosted Windows, macOS, Linux and declared-version jobs passed on PR #569.

assertions.statement: Generate and commit Cargo.lock in a networked Rust environment
assertions.permitted_claim: Cargo.lock is committed at implementation revision 3f62b5ebc3efe3e619c05dfacdabc01b159f1aec, and exact Rust 1.97.1 GNU workspace check plus 55 tests passed against that revision.

assertions.statement: Register repository in repository-standards and run estate conformance
open_gates: Obtain explicit authority to modify edithatogo/repository-standards despite the prepared packet's remote_mutation_permitted=false policy.
Add edithatogo/searchright to the upstream registry and run estate conformance against the exact Searchright revision.
Record the observed upstream commit and conformance receipt.
assertions.permitted_claim: Policy inheritance and a prepared registration packet exist; upstream registration and estate conformance do not.

assertions.statement: Create one-command bootstrap and verification receipts
open_gates: Supply reviewed cargo-vet audit evidence for 273 dependencies; do not substitute unaudited exemptions.
Complete repository-wide verify.sh only after every required gate passes.
assertions.permitted_claim: One-command bootstrap and verification entry points exist; the 51-gate static harness and compiler/test jobs pass, while the required dependency-trust gate keeps the repository-wide aggregate harness red.
